# Small Business Credit Policy

## Tax Return Requirements

Loans above $250,000 require the most recent filed business tax return or a documented credit manager exception.

CPA compiled statements may support a temporary exception only when the filed return is pending.

## Exception Authority

The credit manager may approve a temporary tax-return exception when CPA compiled statements are present and closing exposure is under $500,000.

Exceptions above $500,000 require regional credit committee approval.

## Collateral Rule

An equipment line must have an appraisal no older than 90 days if the advance rate exceeds 75%.

The appraisal must identify excluded assets before closing.
